A1.justification: Both PDFs describe WorldMM. All 26 pages of v1 and 29 pages of v2, including appendices, are readable. Text, equations, figures, tables, and relocated supplementary content support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations on five video-QA benchmarks, memory ablations, temporal retrieval measurements, latency measurements, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds backbone comparisons and temporal-scale sensitivity experiments in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The architecture and retrieval algorithm remain unchanged, but the documented coarse-caption prompt now requires preserving all subjects' actions instead of emphasizing the primary character, and replaces the fixed 500-word ceiling with a word-limit parameter (v1 Fig. 11; v2 Fig. 12). These are limited prompt-level procedural revisions; rerunning the original experiments is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1 Bench, HippoVlog, LVBench, and Video-MME (long). The new appendix experiments use retained benchmarks without adding datasets, populations, tasks, or input-environment scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged in the main QA and temporal-retrieval comparisons, including Tables 1, 3, and 7-10. The added backbone configurations are WorldMM ablations, not additional external competing methods.

E3.justification: Appendix E adds controlled configurations using Gemini 3 Flash and Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B on three retained benchmarks. It also tests two alternative episodic timescale sets on EgoLifeQA. Existing benchmark sample counts, metrics, and original evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix E adds two focused analyses: sensitivity to language-model/visual-encoder choices and sensitivity to episodic temporal-window choices. Earlier memory-component ablations, iteration analysis, efficiency measurements, and qualitative cases are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance-testing procedures. The new appendix tables retain point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: Original benchmark and ablation scores remain unchanged. New Table 11 reports configuration-specific results, including 68.2/61.7/75.8 for WorldMM-Gemini with VLM2Vec-V2 on EgoLifeQA/LVBench/Video-MME (long). Table 12 adds EgoLifeQA accuracies of 65.2 and 64.8 for alternative timescales alongside the retained 65.6. These are additional settings, not improved scores for the original configuration.

T1.justification: The memory definitions, consolidation expression, and retrieval stopping rule in Equations 1-6 are mathematically unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical propositions, proofs, or substantive derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same multimodal, multiscale memory contribution and five-benchmark performance claims, including the reported 8.4% average advantage. New appendix evidence does not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix E newly interprets results as supporting backbone flexibility without architecture-specific modifications and attributes robustness to multiscale design rather than precisely calibrated temporal windows. The existing preprocessing, streaming-applicability, and privacy discussion is retained, moving from Appendix F to G.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly identifies Distil-Whisper large-v3.5, clarifies frames-only inputs for base/long-video baselines, and supplies a captioning prompt in Fig. 9. v1 already described transcript-assisted captions, so a new input modality is not established. Time-R1's Table 1 label is corrected to 7B, consistent with v1 Appendix B.1, while its exact checkpoint link is removed.

R1.justification: Ten cited works are added, including Adaptive-RAG and UniversalRAG, newer video-reasoning and egocentric-understanding research, and components used in the additional experiments. The substantive positioning remains largely unchanged. Publication and bibliographic updates to existing references do not represent new works.

P1.justification: v2 makes local grammatical edits, updates the author/contact block, adds acknowledgements and a supplementary roadmap, and inserts Appendix E before the existing qualitative and limitations sections. Most existing narrative remains unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds two compact experimental tables and a caption-generation prompt panel. Existing appendix tables, the memory-utilization figure, and prompt panels are redistributed or renumbered. Main figures and table structures remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: Appendix E adds useful checks of backbone and temporal-scale sensitivity missing from v1, while Appendix B and Fig. 9 clarify caption processing and baseline inputs. These modestly strengthen empirical support and reproducibility without changing headline results. A small countervailing loss is replacing the explicit 500-word summary ceiling with an unspecified word-limit parameter.
